# MM-P2-L1-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Scope
This document covers preventive maintenance for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) limited to mechanical clamp and main roll bearing lubrication tasks. It supplements SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02 and implements changes from ECN-2026-023 where applicable.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated for mandrel clamp bolt torque.  
- Grease gun compatible with the bearing grease specified in SOP-P2-L1-01.  
- Inspection mirror, lint-free cloth, and appropriate personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L1-02.

Procedure
Inspect mandrel clamp assembly for wear and secure fit. Clean mating surfaces and remove debris using lint-free cloth. Apply thread treatment per SOP-P2-L1-01 if required. Tighten mandrel clamp bolt to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. Verify bolt seating and clamp alignment after torque application.

Lubricate main roll bearings following the lubrication channel access procedures in SOP-P2-L1-01. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 220 hours. Purge old grease from the bearing housing until new grease is visible at the relief point, then apply the quantity and type specified in SOP-P2-L1-01. Record lubrication events in the equipment log and reference ECN-2026-023 for any material or procedural updates.

Acceptance criteria
Mandrel clamp bolt maintains specified torque and clamp shows no movement under operational verification. Bearing housings accept grease and show consistent grease return at relief points. No metal particles or contamination present in grease after purge. All actions documented in the equipment log and cross-referenced to SOP-P2-L1-01, SOP-P2-L1-02, and ECN-2026-023.
